d: The team at Dao Tien in Vietnam cares for a rescued douc monkey, two golden-cheeked gibbons take to the trees, and a slimmed-down loris enjoys success in its search for a mate.
Infighting in one of the capuchin groups leads to Louis having to undergo surgery while the cotton-top tamarin Mo loses their mate, Uncas, only to end up gaining a new friend.
Orangutan Silvester arrives in Switzerland to be the leader of a small group, and Alison decides the best option is to separate Sasha and Kangoo so they can have a chance at a fulfilled life.
Alison finds herself on a mission to rescue a marmoset that is being kept in a hamster cage, and chimp Kangoo takes his time deciding whether to venture into the outdoor enclosure.
Woolly monkey Piquita requires an operation, new capuchin Louis gets a lovely perch, while the chimp team find themselves trying to navigate a double blow after two sad losses.
Alison visits Twycross Zoo to collect an orphaned orangutan in need of a new home, plus there is some startling news about a capuchin recently rescued from a life in the pet trade.
Alison attempts to rescue a squirrel monkey, who proves to be something of an escape artist, and the newly arrived orangutan youngster Kayan meets with Bulu Mata for the first time.
The park comes to the aid of two marmosets, leaving Alison shocked by the condition of the male, while Louisa reaches out the foot of friendship to male crush Matty the capuchin.
A challenging trip into the great outdoors awaits some of the lorises from the park, and two black-shanked douc monkeys have quite the adventure in store for them in Vietnam.
Newly arrived squirrel monkey Kimbo has a health check and also gets the snip, while orangutan youngster Kayan goes outside for the first time.
Rescued marmoset Koba clings to life after arriving at the park in a stricken state, and the lemurs at Malagasy find themselves dealing with a quite tricky tree-top challenge.
It is moving day for young male orangutan Hujan, who is on his way to join the nursery group, while Alison tries to help rescued marmoset Koba build up some much-needed strength.
Elderly marmoset Jenny gets a visit from the vet before the arrival of a new life partner, while orangutan youngster Hujan begins to adjust to living life in the nursery.
